verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own materials say Ari 'messages you when something moves rather than waiting to be asked' and 'tells you what changed before you ask', and the pricing page lists 'Proactive alerts & triggers'. That covers proactive notification on metric movement. However, nothing ties alerts to variance against plan, and nothing covers reporting-deadline reminders. Missing for 10: alerts on variance against plan or budget, reminders for approaching reporting deadlines, documentation on configuring alert triggers and delivery channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
